data.question: Which named people bridge the Trump Foundation branch into government, intelligence, venture capital, policy institutes, and multigenerational philanthropy?
data.method: Official roster expansion, biographical verification, set-intersection ranking, and explicit separation of verified relations from chronological inference.
data.framework: Rank people by independently sourced institutional cluster memberships; preserve direct business-political bridges separately from broad institutional bridges.
data.scope: Trump Foundation board and advisory rosters, related biographies, defense and intelligence roles, venture capital, policy organizations, and Trump-family philanthropy.
findings: Shlomo Dovrat is the broadest policy-capital-education bridge in the expanded roster.
Eli Hurvitz bridges foundation management, Yad Hanadiv, Knesset defense oversight, Military Intelligence collection, and the Meridor family.
Yossi Baidatz bridges foundation advice, educational technology, IDF military education, and Military Intelligence research.
Eddy Shalev bridges foundation governance, venture capital, technology boards, and Beit Issie Shapiro endowment governance.
Jules Trump remains the strongest direct business-Netanyahu bridge from the parent pass.
The identity of the committee chair whom Hurvitz assisted remains unresolved.
conclusions: The foundation network contains multiple independently documented pathways into Israeli policy, military-intelligence, philanthropy, and capital institutions.
Institutional overlap does not by itself establish coordinated control, favoritism, or misconduct.
recommendations: Retrieve Knesset personnel records identifying Hurvitz's committee-chair employer.
Retrieve official military biographies or archival records for Hurvitz and Baidatz.
Recover advisory minutes, conflict disclosures, and implementation decisions.
Map CET and Education Ministry contracts, grants, and program roles.
Resolve financial and board links across the Trump Foundation and Beit Issie Shapiro.
counterarguments: High-degree institutional actors may be selected for expertise rather than coordination.
Family and career ties do not establish policy causation.
limitations: Some military and committee personnel records are not publicly indexed.
The Dan Meridor employment link is an inference only.
unresolved: Hurvitz Central Collection Unit roles and dates.
Foundation advisory recommendations adopted by government.
